messages:
hana-docs: FYI I opened a compact PR to consolidate Dedicated migration notes: v1->v2 ScalePolicy, isolation label examples, and a tiny terraform + JS SDK snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1582 Would love eng-runtime + TF review.
jorge-tf: looking now. Please include an explicit mapping table for deprecated fields (e.g., pool_id -> reserved_pool_ref) and the cooldown unit change. Customers tripped on that.
hana-docs: added a small table and called out cooldown_seconds -> cooldown_ms with an example conversion. Also added a short HCL example for reserved_pool_ref.
lina-qa: can you add QA steps to reproduce the cooldown/unit issue? I can paste a curl + expected deprecation warning.
hana-docs: done — added a short QA checklist. QA snippet: ```bash
# send old payload that uses seconds
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scalePolicies \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"metadata":{"name":"s1"},"spec":{"cooldown_seconds":120}}'
# expected: 202 Accepted + deprecation warning in response and server log entry 'deprecated_cooldown_seconds'
```
jorge-tf: thanks. tiny nit: our terraform provider uses cooldown_ms in HCL but exposes cooldown_seconds in older provider versions. Add a note about provider versions and include HCL sample that uses cooldown_ms. Example I suggest:
```hcl
resource "redwood_scale_policy" "migrated" {
  name          = "migrated-tenant-9"
  min_replicas  = 1
  max_replicas  = 5
  cooldown_ms   = 90000
  metrics {
    type   = "RequestRate"
    target = 150
  }
  reserved_pool_ref = "teams/infra/east-commit"
  labels = {
    "redwood.tenant.isolation" = "team-9"
  }
}
```
walt-pm: product note: legal asked we substitute "expected behavior" language in SLA examples. Avoid words like "guarantee". Also ask localization for the Spanish strings once merged.
hana-docs: changed SLA examples to use "typical expected" phrasing. Added TODO for localization.
eng-runtime-bot: compatibility note: Runtime will accept both cooldown_ms and cooldown_seconds for the compatibility window but will emit deprecation warnings for seconds. metrics.type prefers RequestRate; QPS and RPS are accepted as aliases for one release. reserved_pool_ref is now namespaced; pool_id maps to reserved_pool_ref in migration. Isolation label keys follow convention redwood.tenant.isolation.
jorge-tf: small request: add a CLI example for customers who don't use TF. Also add a one-liner about RBAC: service account must have reserved-pools/get.
hana-docs: added CLI and RBAC checklist. CLI snippet: ```bash
redwood scale-policy create --name migrated-tenant-9 --min 1 --max 5 --cooldown-ms 90000 --metric RequestRate:150 --reserved-pool teams/infra/east-commit --label redwood.tenant.isolation=team-9
```
lina-qa: QA added steps to simulate preemption under overload and the log string to look for: capacity_unavailable_preemption_possible. Also added a smoke test to ensure reserved_pool_ref fallback routes to shared pool when ref invalid.
eng-runtime-bot: extra note: when reserved_pool_ref is invalid we return 409 reserved_pool_conflict. Add that to troubleshooting.
hana-docs: added 409 note and a troubleshooting bullet list. Also fixed two broken anchors found by linkcheck.
devx-bot: Preview for PR 1582 published: https://deploys.redwood.com/preview/1582 (expires in 7 days). CI: lint OK, spellcheck: 1 suggestion.
jorge-tf: LGTM aside from a tiny HCL formatting nit. Leaving a comment on the PR.
lina-qa: approved from QA once the curl reproduction and log checks are in.
hana-docs: thanks all 60a I'll merge after the HCL nit and devx CI passes. Tagging @eng-runtime for final thumbs-up.
